Maria Santos  
Email: maria.santos@clickloom.com | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/mariasantos | GitHub: github.com/mariasantos | Location: Lisbon, Portugal  

Professional Experience  
During my tenure at ClickLoom, I focused on enhancing ad targeting interfaces using Next.js, which allowed me to implement server-side rendering for improved SEO and faster initial load times. This work involved collaborating with backend teams to integrate REST APIs, ensuring data flowed seamlessly between client and server. I also spearheaded the adoption of lazy loading and code splitting, which reduced page load times by 32% for ad creatives. Prior to this, as a Web Developer Intern at AdVerve Media, I contributed to ad campaign dashboards by optimizing component rendering for real-time data updates. This required deep dives into React’s virtual DOM mechanics to minimize re-renders and improve user interaction latency.  

Technical Skills  
JavaScript forms the foundation of my technical identity, influencing decisions on component architecture and state management patterns. I’ve mentored junior developers on best practices for modular code organization, emphasizing readability and maintainability. React is central to my workflow, with a focus on declarative UI patterns and performance optimizations. At ClickLoom, I refactored legacy components to use hooks effectively, reducing boilerplate code and improving team onboarding efficiency. Next.js has been instrumental in scaling our ad platform, enabling static site generation for marketing pages and API routes for dynamic ad data fetching.  

Web performance optimization is a recurring priority, driven by user feedback and A/B testing results. I’ve implemented critical rendering paths to prioritize above-the-fold content, ensuring 85% of users see the first frame within 1.5 seconds. My work with Webpack and Vite involved configuring bundle splitting and tree shaking, which cut asset sizes by 25% without compromising functionality. These tools are now integral to our CI/CD pipeline, with automated builds triggering on code changes.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, University of Technology, 2022. Thesis focused on optimizing front-end performance in ad-tech platforms, with a particular emphasis on reducing latency for real-time bidding systems.  

Projects  
Developed a responsive ad targeting interface for ClickLoom using Next.js, which supported multi-device interactions and ensured WCAG 2.1 compliance. The project included custom accessibility components for keyboard navigation and screen reader support. Another initiative involved creating a dashboard for ad campaign analytics, where I integrated REST APIs to fetch and visualize performance metrics in real time.  

Languages  
English (native), Portuguese (fluent)  

Certifications  
Frontend Development Fundamentals (FreeCodeCamp), 2023. Accessibility for Developers (W3C), 2023.
